verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a government IP-office e-filing portal has an identity and sign-in path. However, the pack never describes how users authenticate: no credential-based MFA, no account login flow, and nothing on whether identity checks are remote. DPMAdirektWeb is described only as filing 'without signature card', and DPMAdirektPro requires a signature card, but neither item documents a remotely completable credential-MFA sign-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
